title: Arithmetic and return
summary: Turning a stub into a real answer with + - * /.

steps.title: A stub
steps.say: Every method starts by returning a placeholder so the program still builds. Your job is to replace it.

steps.title: The real answer
steps.say: Replace the placeholder with an **expression**: a bit of math that works out to a value.

marks.label: the expression; its result is returned

board.caption: addInts(2, 3) gives 5

steps.title: Conversions
steps.say: Inches to meters is a multiply. The way back is a divide by the same number, so the two undo each other.

board.code:
double meters = inches * 0.0254;
double inches = meters / 0.0254;

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `public static int addInts` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find public static int addInts with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Start here
steps.say: Here's your first stub. Change its `return` line.

steps.title: Run it
steps.say: Click the **Run** button (▷) at the top right of the file. The output appears in the terminal at the bottom.

waitFor.hint: run the program and read the output.
